data.name: Mareekh
data.gender_notes: Mareekh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who is a caller or guide
data.long_meaning: One who is a caller or guide in the desert, someone who helps people navigate or find their way in difficult terrain. The name Mareekh carries the meaning “One who is a caller or guide” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mareekh usually hope their child will grow to embody one who is a caller or guide and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies guidance and leadership, especially in times of uncertainty or hardship.
data.etymology: Mareekh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who is a caller or guide.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mareekh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

In Islamic tradition, the name Mareekh is associated with the qualities of courage, strength, and determination.
